editor.subtitulo: Everything changes in the preview as you edit. Nothing leaves here until you save.
editor.salvo: Saved. Your profile looks like this now.
editor.atalhos: Ctrl+Z undoes, Ctrl+Shift+Z redoes, Ctrl+S saves.
editor.sairSemSalvar: Your profile has unsaved changes. Leave anyway?
editor.previaExemplo: Preview with sample data: nothing goes to the database.
editor.seguro: Only checked colors, words and choices: nobody can put code or tracking on your profile.
editor.entrar: Sign in to Alumia to edit your profile.

cores.ajuda: The color of buttons, the tab underline and the details of your profile.
cores.livreAjuda: Any color. If it is hard to read, Alumia adjusts the shade until it passes the contrast check.
cores.contraste: Contrast {noite}:1 on dark and {papel}:1 on light (minimum 4.5:1).
cores.ajustada: We adjusted the text shade so it stays readable.
cores.passa: Passes the contrast check without adjustment.

temasAjuda.brasa: Dark with a glow of your color.
temasAjuda.tingido: The whole header in your color, in a deep shade.

layoutsAjuda.classico: Cover on top, face on the left.
layoutsAjuda.cartaz: Tall cover with the name on top, like a street poster.

cores.faixaAjuda: Eleven threads, in the proportions of the house stripe. Pick a thread, then a color.

rosto.ajuda: Draw your face as a mosaic, tile by tile, or use a drawing or photo (the photo loses its EXIF on your device and goes through moderation).
rosto.grade: Face grid, 8 by 8. Arrows move, Space or Enter paints.
rosto.poucos: Paint at least 6 tiles for the face to count.
rosto.desenhoOuFoto: Gallery drawing or photo: in the Account tab.

capa.ajuda: A mosaic cover with your word, in your color, or the usual cover (drawing or photo).
capa.palavraAjuda: Up to 10 letters and numbers, no accents. E.g.: OCCUPY, FIGHT ON.
capa.desenhoOuFoto: Gallery drawing or photo: in the Account tab.

sobre.codinomeAjuda: The name shown on Alumia: 3 to 30 letters. Never your legal name.

erros.codinome_usado: That code name already belongs to someone else.
erros.codinome_civil: It looks like your legal name. Pick another one, for your safety.
erros.invalido_codinome: Use 3 to 30 letters, numbers, space, dot, hyphen or _ (no links and no @).

sobre.bioAjuda: Use **bold**, _italic_, https links, #topics and @people. HTML does not work.
sobre.bioSalvaAparte: The bio is saved with everything else when you tap Save.
sobre.camposAjuda: Up to 6. An https link shows its domain before the click; tracking (utm, fbclid) is removed. Do not add phone, address or documents.
sobre.rastreioTirado: We removed {n} tracking bit(s) from the link.

abas.ajuda: Choose which tabs appear and in what order. Posts always stays.
abas.arrastar: Drag to reorder, or use the buttons.

vitrine.fixadosAjuda: Up to 3 of your posts at the top of your profile, in order.
vitrine.semPosts: You have no posts to pin yet.
vitrine.destaquesAjuda: Up to 6 of your posts or actions, with a short title and a color.
vitrine.orgsAjuda: Only the ones you type, one by one, and only verified ones. Membership is sensitive data (LGPD art. 11): Alumia infers nothing from who you follow.
vitrine.orgRuim: Type an organization @ (3 to 20 letters, numbers or _).
vitrine.orgConferida: The database checks the badge when you save.

agora.statusAjuda: Disappears on its own. Never says where you are.
agora.tocandoAjuda: Just text and, if you want, a link. Alumia connects to no music service: no tracking.

conta.ajuda: @name, who can find you, studying now, badges, drawing or photo face and cover, and follow requests. Each block saves on its own.

tear.poucos: The loom shows the score from 3 decisions on.
tear.ajuda: Each decision becomes a thread. Once delivered, the needle weaves it into the stripe; when overdue, it hangs loose.
tear.funcaoSoDentro: The responsible role and the deadline are shown only to the organization's members.
tear.funcaoAjuda: The name of the role (treasury, communication), never a person.

lampiao.ajuda: Found a local group in 5 steps. The lantern starts dark, gets an ember with the 1st person and a full flame with the 3rd.
lampiao.onde: Where (public place, never a home address)
lampiao.pautaModelo:
1. Who we are and why we are here
2. The neighborhood problem that hurts most
3. A small first action
4. Next meeting
lampiao.cartaz: The poster is ready with the name, the day and a clean QR code, no tracking.
lampiao.convite: Invite with an expiry and a use limit: create it later in Groups > Invites.
lampiao.tarefaModelo: Bring one more trusted person to the second meeting.
lampiao.aceso: Lantern lit! The group joins the showcase when it reaches 3 people.
